text:
maria-cs: Quick sync 1 OrchidAI wants to onboard a domain-tuned 13B. Primary asks: PHI redaction, hallucination checks, and perf targets. Renewal check in ~60d so timeline is urgent.

jake-se: Got it. Do we have the sample bundle? I can run a quick compatibility pass and baseline.

maria-cs: Uploaded to private S3 (2.2GB). They provided a redaction spec and want at least one explicit PHI abstain testcase.

oliver-security: PHI is a gating item for Private/HSM. Need: redaction spec, dataflow diagram, and KMS policy + key access matrix before enabling HSM. @maria-cs please collect.

sophia-prod: Target p95=200ms single-turn @512 tokens is optimistic for 13B. Baseline likely ~350ms p95 on Dedicated; with INT8 + prefix KV caching + tuned kernels maybe ~220ms. I'll draft ops config and autoscale suggestions.

jake-se: I'll scaffold an eval harness tomorrow. Example run: `python eval_runner.py --model orchidai-13b --dataset s3://orchidai/testset.jsonl --checks qa,hallucination,entity-recall --out /tmp/out.json`

maria-cs: Customer requires an abstain example with PHI and a short list of failure cases recorded. Also asked for a Hosted vs Dedicated cost delta.

oliver-security: Also flagging renewal risk: if onboarding slips >30d they may delay renewal. Recommend marking task as time-sensitive in CS playbook and loop in legal for HSM contract language.

deploy-bot: Ticket created ORCHIDAI-2042 "OrchidAI 13B PHI onboard" assigned to jake-se, due 2024-12-15.

jake-se: Will run subset eval tomorrow and post perf baseline + suggested quant profile. I'll include abstain test results.

maria-cs: Thanks. I'll follow up with the KMS policy from the customer and add account-health note (positive renewal impact if completed <30d).
